environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on a single EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer with default configuration. No rate limiting rules configured on the ALB or any upstream proxy. PHP-FPM worker pool size is 50. The application runs with APP_DEBUG=false but has no exception handling middleware for TypeError/null dereference. Routes are protected by auth:sanctum middleware only. The bulkSessionCheck endpoint accepts arrays of up to 10,000 user IDs per request.

config.alb_rules: default forward only, no WAF attached
config.error_handling: default Laravel exception handler, no custom middleware
